title: Move + Child / + Link affordances out of the buried footer
description: ViewCardContentSection renders the '+ Child' and '+ Link' footer affordance after the card body. On long cards they're buried deep in the page. Move them into the ViewPageHeader row that holds the view-mode segmented control (always visible above the body), flush-right, keeping the same behavior (open the rail's Links tab; Child also kicks off creation). Desktop only — mobile keeps its inline Children add button + BacklinkInput. Then remove the now-dead footer affordance and openLinksTab/useUIState plumbing from ViewCardContentSection.

title: Move EditPage file list into the sidebar rail
description: EditPage renders the attached-files list (FileListItem entries with display/filter/delete) below the CardEditor in the main column. Move it into a 'files' right-pane tab in the edit rail (alongside Metadata/Links), consistent with the ViewPage rail. The 'files' RightPaneTab already exists. Don't reuse FilesTab — the edit page handles uploads differently (paste/drag via filesToUpdate, no fileUploadRef).

title: Delete ViewCardTabbedDisplay once mobile uses accordions
description: Follow-up to Zettelgarden-1ui. After Zettelgarden-bl9 moves mobile content into ViewMobileLayout accordions, ViewCardTabbedDisplay becomes orphaned — desktop no longer renders it (Files is its own rail tab, Summaries live in the summary view mode, History is a metadata collapsible) and mobile will use accordions. At that point: delete src/components/cards/ViewCardTabbedDisplay.tsx, remove the showTabbedDisplay flag and its prop plumbing from ViewCardContentSection, and drop any now-unused imports/tests. This is blocked on Zettelgarden-bl9.

title: Break Files/Summaries/History out of ViewCardTabbedDisplay
description: The metadata rail tab currently nests ViewCardTabbedDisplay (Files/Summaries/History) — tabs-within-tabs. Break it up: (1) add a 'files' RightPaneTab rendering FilesTab directly; (2) fold Summaries into the existing 'summary' view mode by enriching ViewSummaryView to show the latest summary plus the past jobs list, and remove the SummariesTab surface from desktop; (3) move History into a Collapsible inside the metadata tab. Result: desktop rail is Links/Metadata/Entities/Files with no nested tab strip. Mobile keeps ViewCardTabbedDisplay inline for now (fold into Zettelgarden-bl9).

title: Consolidate entity UI into the right-pane Entities tab
description: ViewPageSidePanels renders a read-only Entities right-pane tab (linkedEntities / GET /linked-entities) while ViewCardTabbedDisplay renders a full-featured Entities sub-tab (filter/add/remove via EntitiesTab using viewingCard.entities). They overlap confusingly. Move the full-featured EntitiesTab content into the right-pane 'entities' tab and remove the Entities sub-tab from ViewCardTabbedDisplay. linkedEntities plumbing stays because ViewMobileLayout still uses it.

title: PR 3: Tabbed edit rail (Metadata/Links) + content moves
description: Split the edit rail into Metadata + Links tabs. CardMetadata accepts a tab prop: metadata tab = Card ID, Tags, Source/Link input (moved from main column), Details; links tab = References (BacklinkInputDropdownList). EditPage adds the Links tab to EDIT_TABS, removes the stray double <hr> and the Link section from the main column, passes tab={rightPaneTab} to CardMetadata, and gates CardSchemaSection on the metadata tab. Main column becomes pure editor + Files list. Plan: docs/plans/2026-07-11-obsidian-style-edit-page-impl.md
close_reason: PR 3 shipped: edit rail split into Metadata/Links tabs. CardMetadata gains a tab prop (metadata=Card ID/Tags/Source-Link/Details, links=References). Source/Link moved out of main column into rail; stray double <hr> removed; CardSchemaSection gated on metadata tab. Main column is now pure editor + Files. tsc clean, 528 tests green, build OK.

title: PR 2: Extract useRightPaneTab + closable edit rail
description: Extract the ?pane= URL sync (mount-read + write-on-change) from ViewPageSidePanels into a new src/hooks/useRightPaneTab.ts. ViewPageSidePanels uses the hook (pure refactor, behavior identical). EditPage wraps its md:w-1/3 side panel to conditionally render on rightPaneOpen, main column reclaims full width when closed (ViewPage pattern), adds a tab strip + close affordance (single Metadata tab for now), and calls useRightPaneTab. Plan: docs/plans/2026-07-11-obsidian-style-edit-page-impl.md
close_reason: PR 2 shipped: useRightPaneTab hook extracted (ViewPageSidePanels uses it, behavior identical). Edit rail now closable with tab strip + close affordance, main column reclaims full width when closed. tsc clean, 525 tests green, build OK.

title: PR 1: Obsidian-style EditPageHeader (replace EditorToolbar)
description: Replace EditorToolbar with a ViewPageHeader-style header for the edit page. New EditPageHeader: breadcrumb [card_id] + editable title input + suggest-title button + Save/Cancel action row + overflow Menu (Process Entities & Facts, Save as Template, Delete Card) + desktop rail toggle. Move title input + Save/Cancel out of CardEditor into header. Delete EditorToolbar.tsx/.test.tsx. Plan: docs/plans/2026-07-11-obsidian-style-edit-page-impl.md
close_reason: PR 1 shipped: EditPageHeader replaces EditorToolbar; title/save/cancel/suggest moved into header; tsc clean, 518 tests green, build OK.

title: Obsidian-style EditPage: closable tabbed rail + header-driven layout
description: Make EditPage match the style just shipped for ViewPage (closable tabbed right rail, Obsidian-style header). Plan in docs/plans/2026-07-11-obsidian-style-edit-page-impl.md. 3 PRs: (1) replace EditorToolbar with a ViewPageHeader-style EditPageHeader (editable title input + Save/Cancel + overflow menu + rail toggle), move Save/Cancel and title out of CardEditor; (2) extract useRightPaneTab hook from ViewPageSidePanels (shared ?pane= URL sync) and make the edit side panel closable via existing UIStateContext rail state; (3) split edit rail into Metadata/Links tabs, move Source/Link input + References into the rail so the main column is a pure editor. Reuse rightPaneOpen/rightPaneTab/toggleRightPane from context. Desktop-first; no new mobile edit layout. Baseline: 512 tests, tsc clean.
close_reason: All 3 PRs shipped and pushed: PR 1 (3bb5e2b2) EditPageHeader replaces EditorToolbar with editable title + Save/Cancel + overflow menu + rail toggle; PR 2 (f23b8761) useRightPaneTab hook extracted, edit rail made closable with tab strip + close affordance, main column reclaims full width; PR 3 (03927a50) edit rail split into Metadata/Links tabs, Source/Link + References moved into rail, main column is pure editor + Files. tsc clean throughout, 528 tests green, build OK.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: Execution plan written to docs/plans/2026-07-11-obsidian-style-edit-page-impl.md, committed (1304b63d). Verifies EditPage's current structure against the codebase, resolves 5 design decisions (editable title input in header; Save/Cancel in header action row; 2-tab Metadata/Links rail; shared ?pane= via a new useRightPaneTab hook; no mobile edit layout), and phases the work into 3 PRs with exact line references. Reuses the rail state already in UIStateContext.

title: Move entities/files/history/summaries into the rail's Metadata tab
description: Follow-up to the closable tabbed right rail (Zettelgarden-5wp, shipped). Move ViewCardTabbedDisplay (Files/Entities/Summaries/History) out of the desktop main column and into the right rail's Metadata tab, so the reading surface is pure prose + tasks and all structured data lives in the rail. Mobile preserved via a showTabbedDisplay flag on ViewCardContentSection (mobile keeps it inline), mirroring the showRelationships pattern from PR 3. Repoint setViewCard/setError/summaries/fileUploadRef from the content section to ViewPageSidePanels.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: Shipped: commit 28913d0c, pushed. ViewCardTabbedDisplay (Files/Entities/Summaries/History) moved from the desktop main column into the rail's Metadata tab. Desktop reading surface is now pure prose + tasks + the +Child/+Link footer. Mobile preserved via a showTabbedDisplay flag (keeps it inline), mirroring showRelationships. Props repointed ViewPage -> ViewPageSidePanels. Audit-events fetch is History-sub-tab-gated so no mount cost. 512 tests (was 511), tsc clean.

title: Closable, tabbed right rail for card view
description: Make the card view's right sidebar behave like Obsidian's: closable, tabbed (Links/Metadata/Entities), and move Children + Linked references out of the main column into the Links tab. Full design and 4-PR rollout in docs/plans/2026-07-11-closable-tabbed-right-rail-design.md. Reuse UIStateContext (left-sidebar pattern), SidePanelLayout, Collapsible, and the ViewCardTabbedDisplay tab-strip style. Desktop-first; do not regress ViewMobileLayout. Baseline: 480 tests passing, tsc clean.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: Execution plan written to docs/plans/2026-07-11-closable-tabbed-right-rail-impl.md. Verifies all design-doc references against current code (480-test baseline confirmed), resolves the 3 open decisions (in-pane only; pin auto-collapses rail wired in UIStateContext; always-visible body-footer +Child/+Link), and gives exact per-PR edits across 4 PRs.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: PR 1 (closable rail) shipped: commit 2135c400, pushed. UIStateContext now owns rightPaneOpen/toggleRightPane with localStorage persistence (key zettelgarden-right-pane-open, default open). Pin auto-collapse wired as a context effect using the raw setter so forced-close never pollutes the saved preference — covered by 3 dedicated tests. Header has a desktop-only (hidden md:inline-flex) toggle button, hidden in the pinned pane via hideRailToggle prop. Main column reclaims full width when rail closed. 490 tests passing (was 480), tsc clean. Next: PR 2 — re-shell ViewPageSidePanels into 3 tabs.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: PR 2 (tabbed rail) shipped: commit b276da64, pushed. ViewPageSidePanels is now a tabbed pane: strip modeled on ViewCardTabbedDisplay + a close button wired to toggleRightPane. Current contents redistributed verbatim — Links: parent/sibling nav; Metadata: source article, related cards, structured data, tags, details; Entities: linked entities. Default tab Metadata (densest). Props unchanged so ViewPage call site untouched. Calm empty-state hints on Links/Entities. 496 tests passing (was 490), tsc clean. Next: PR 3 — move Children + Linked references into the Links tab and add the body-footer +Child/+Link affordance.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: PR 3 (content move + footer affordance) shipped: commit 83640178, pushed. Lifted rightPaneTab into UIStateContext (default links). Links tab now holds parent/sibling nav, Children (+sort +add-child), Linked references collapsible (+sort +BacklinkInput), and related cards. Desktop main column is now pure content: CardBody, a muted +Child/+Link footer (opens rail to Links; +Child also fires creation which navigates to /app/card/new), Tasks, tabbed display. Mobile preserved unchanged via a showRelationships flag on ViewCardContentSection — ViewMobileLayout tests green untouched. ViewPage repoints onCreateChildCard/categorizedReferences/onAddBacklink to the side panels. 502 tests passing (was 496), tsc clean. Only PR 4 (polish: ?pane= query param, smart default tab, keyboard shortcut, empty-state tone) remains, and it's defer-safe. Filed mobile-accordion parity + side-metadata de-dup as known follow-ups per the plan.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: Feature COMPLETE. All 4 PRs shipped and pushed: PR 1 (2135c400, closable rail + pin auto-collapse), PR 2 (b276da64, tabbed rail), PR 3 (83640178, content move + footer affordance), PR 4 (9338b78f, URL param + smart default + keyboard shortcut + empty-state tone). Final state: 511 tests passing (started at 480), tsc clean throughout. Mobile untouched. Three follow-ups remain filed: mobile-accordion parity, side-metadata de-duplication. PR 4 polish issue (Zettelgarden-bbs) closed.

title: Remove chat agent feature (frontend + backend)
description: Remove the deprecated conversational chat agent/agent feature from front and backend, including the chat-exclusive tool-calling system. KEEP: vector search, entity recognition, summarization, card-based user memory, and the DB tables (just stop reading/writing). Replace README/docs references. People can use the CLI agent instead.
close_reason: Chat agent fully removed from backend (handlers, routes, chat_agent package, chat-exclusive tool system + registry, message converter, tool error model, featureflags package) and frontend (chat UI, useChat, api/chat, chat state in UIStateContext, chat route + layouts, Chat button). Shared infra kept: LLMClient, entity/summarize/vector/memory features, card-based user memory. DB tables intentionally left in place. Docs updated. Backend builds + compiles; 466 frontend tests pass. Follow-up for minor ai_config dead code filed separately.

title: Add backend-synced saved searches to Tasks page
description: Let users save frequent task searches (filterString + sort + viewMode) and sync them across devices. Mirror the existing starred_searches pattern for cards but in a dedicated task_saved_searches table. Includes: SQL migration, Go model/service/handler/routes with full CRUD, frontend model/api/hook + SavedSearchesMenu dropdown wired into TaskDesktopLayout and TaskMobileLayout. Built-in presets (Today/Overdue/This week/No date/All) optional.

title: Remove card pinning split-view feature
description: The card 'pin' feature (split-view pane that pinned a card to the side via UIStateContext.pinnedCard/isPinMode + SplitViewLayout + PinIcon + PinErrorBoundary) never worked well. Removed the entire client-side pin UI. The unrelated 'starred cards' feature (Card.is_pinned field, starCard mutation, starred_cards table) is untouched. Net -260 lines.

title: Polish right rail: URL param, smart default tab, keyboard shortcut, empty-state tone (PR 4)
description: Final PR of the closable tabbed right rail plan (docs/plans/2026-07-11-closable-tabbed-right-rail-impl.md). Defer-safe follow-up to Zettelgarden-5wp PRs 1-3 (all shipped). Work: (1) Reflect activeTab in ?pane=links|metadata|entities via useSearchParams, read on mount; (2) smart default tab — links if card has children/references, else metadata; (3) keyboard shortcut to toggle the rail (e.g. Cmd/Ctrl-\) in useKeyboardShortcuts.ts with a test; (4) empty-state tone pass across all three tabs. Files: ViewPageSidePanels.tsx, useKeyboardShortcuts.ts, possibly a useRightPaneTab hook. Baseline at filing: 502 tests, tsc clean.

comments.author: Nick Savage
comments.text: PR 4 (polish) shipped: commit 9338b78f, pushed. (1) ?pane=links|metadata|entities query-param sync — read on mount, written with replace on tab change so a view is shareable without a new route; (2) smart default tab — Links when the card has children/references, else Metadata, with ?pane= taking precedence; (3) Cmd/Ctrl-\\ toggles the rail app-wide via a new optional onToggleRightPane in useKeyboardShortcuts (handled before the meta-ignore so the modifier combo works), wired from Sidebar; (4) empty-state tone harmonized to text-gray-400. 511 tests passing (was 502), tsc clean.

title: Mobile parity: move Children + Linked references into ViewMobileLayout accordions
description: Follow-up to Zettelgarden-5wp. PR 3 preserved mobile behavior by keeping inline Children + Linked references in ViewCardContentSection behind a showRelationships flag (desktop moved them to the rail's Links tab). For parity, give ViewMobileLayout its own accordion sections for Children and Linked references (it already has Navigation/Tags/etc accordions), then drop the showRelationships path from ViewCardContentSection so the component becomes desktop-only pure content. Out of scope per the plan; do NOT bundle with the rail work.

title: Add built-in task saved-search presets (Today/Overdue/This week/No date/All)
description: Follow-up to Zettelgarden-2ql. Ship read-only built-in presets alongside user-saved searches so the feature is useful before the user saves anything. Built-ins would be client-side constants (id 'builtin:*') merged into the SavedSearchesMenu list, non-deletable, and excluded from create/update/delete. Maps to existing date: keywords (date:today, date:overdue, date:this_week, date:no_date, empty).

title: De-duplicate side metadata between ViewPageSidePanels and ViewMobileLayout
description: Follow-up to Zettelgarden-5wp. ViewPageSidePanels (desktop rail) and ViewMobileLayout accordions duplicate ~150 lines of side metadata (tags, details, source article, structured data) with subtle differences (date formatting, entity descriptions). Extract a shared component. Dedicated PR; do not bundle. Referenced in docs/plans/2026-07-11-closable-tabbed-right-rail-impl.md out-of-scope section.

title: Clean up dead AI config helpers left after chat agent removal
description: After removing the chat agent (Zettelgarden-48a), three exported funcs in go-backend/services/ai_config.go have zero callers and are now dead code: ValidateChatModel, GetDefaultChatModel, and GetAllModels (they backed the deleted GET /api/chat/models route). Remove them for tidiness. ValidChatModels and GetModelConfig are still used by services/llms.go pricing logging, so keep those. Low priority — exported funcs don't break the build.
